keyEvents.text: Jake Clarke-Salter (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card.
Ronnie Edwards (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Blackburn Rovers 0, Queens Park Rangers 0.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Glen Kamara replaces Nicolas Madsen.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Tariq Lamptey replaces Dennis Cirkin.
